key_point: Sony built the PlayStation after Nintendo publicly walked away from their joint console
title: The PlayStation exists because Nintendo betrayed Sony in public.
caption: The PlayStation exists because Nintendo betrayed Sony in public. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #playstation #sony #nintendo

instagram.caption:
The PlayStation exists because Nintendo betrayed Sony in public.

In 1991 Sony announced a CD add-on for the Super Nintendo at a big trade show. The next day, Nintendo said it would work with Philips instead.

Sony's boss was furious and told his team to build their own console. The PlayStation came out in 1994 and outsold the Nintendo 64 three to one.
